Targets corrected for endoscopy-cohort ascertainment bias using R_primary = (R_obs - f_treated * R_treated) / (1 - f_treated). Macrolides (erythromycin/azithromycin/clarithromycin): 22% published obs -> 7% primary target. FQs (ciprofloxacin/levofloxacin/moxifloxacin/ofloxacin): ~28% obs -> 12% primary target. Tetracyclines (tetracycline/doxycycline/minocycline): ~17% obs -> 8% primary target. BLIs (amoxicillin_clavulanate/ampicillin_sulbactam): ~38% obs -> 10% primary target. Metronidazole: 50% published target retained as empirical reference but structurally unreachable in this model (cross-use resistance from gynaecological/parasitic indications not modelled; true primary rate ~30-35%). cefiderocol/ceftolozane_tazobactam dotted (pass 1): not used for H. pylori treatment (potency 0.050). tigecycline dotted (pass 2): not used for H. pylori treatment (potency 0.10).
